head: 7a463be9f3b2e5a73e27cccc689a55da3a460f1f
validation: All four hosts passed the precision probe and existing nested/checkpoint/scope/ownership/capacity/library/float regressions, formatting and Clippy.
workload: Ten checks: forward/reverse low bits, VJP seed precision, tiny and huge finite exponents, accumulated low terms, first/second derivatives, checkpoint replay, and 65 repeated gradients. Counts cover the full fixture after constant initialization, including output formatting.
accounting: Managed allocation requests and requested bytes exclude unmanaged registry, linked-library and host allocations. Final charged delta compares managed budget before execution with teardown; ARC must be zero. Tracing can also release preexisting constants. No peak process memory or elapsed-time claim; these totals are not a C/Rust comparison.
flags: Native O1 and O2; workspace reuse disabled/enabled. Tracing uses GC stress/verification and reuse verification; ARC requires no tracing. Deliberately omitted tape free must fail.
